page.layout: One printed page of a table (diagram) with running head at top; page number top left. Main body: a large bracket diagram of syrups and waters, with a vertical label on the left margin; boxes read left to right. Right-hand edge shows show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed.
page.running_head: LIBELLVS DE SYRVPIS ET AQVIS cuilibet membro appropriatis

main_text.head: Tab. II.
main_text.l: Aquae Scabiosae, Capilli Veneris, Hyssopi, Saluiae, Enulae campanae.
Aquae Cuscutae, Cichorij, Absinthij, Apij, Eupatorij.
Oxymel S. & compos. Aquae Cuscutae, Genistae, Scolopend., Calamenti, Buglossae.

page.notes: Diagram boxes are set in the printed braces; the brace "Aquae" boxes at right are listed with their group. Some words are abbreviated in the print (e.g. Mel rosat., Sy., Oxymel S., compos., Campan.) and are copied as far as legible. The right margin shows show-through text from the facing page, omitted. The label "Syrupi concoquentes pituitam" runs vertically on the left and is treated as the root box.
